Section 4 of the product catalogue, two pages: product cards with captioned image placeholders and accent-emphasised prices, a dimensions table, and grouped options with surcharges. Change the products, prices and options in `data.json` first; real photography drops into the placeholder slots at the same aspect. Caveats: the placeholders are bordered and captioned on the flat light ground — the design's 45° hatch is a gradient, which the engine subset excludes — and the folios are the catalogue's own (Page 4.1 / 4.2), carried by named pages instead of `counter(page)`.

**Engine features exercised:** named page for per-page folio strings, running header on the continuation page, CSS grid product cards (2-up and 3-up), grouped-option table, continuation marker.

Render it:

```bash
npx @formepdf/html templates/product-catalog/index.html -o product-catalog.pdf
```

```css style.css
/* product-catalog — section 4, two pages with image placeholders.
 * Accent policy (catalogue): one solid accent tab and price emphasis.
 * Counters follow the design's section folios (Page 4.1 / 4.2). */
@page {
  size: Letter;
  margin: 52.5pt 57pt 40.5pt;
  @bottom-left {
    content: "Northmoor product catalog 2026–27 · Section 4, options";
    font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 5.625pt;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #8A857E;
  }
  @bottom-right {
    content: "Page 4.2";
    font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 5.625pt;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #8A857E;
  }
  @top-left {
    content: "Northmoor catalog 2026–27";
    color: #7B2233;
    font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 5.625pt;
    letter-spacing: 0.2em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    border-bottom: 0.75pt solid #111111;
    padding-bottom: 6pt;
  }
  @top-center {
    content: "Section 4 — Utility skids";
    color: #5F5A53;
    font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 5.625pt;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    border-bottom: 0.75pt solid #111111;
    padding-bottom: 6pt;
  }
  @top-right {
    content: "Platforms, guards and options";
    color: #5F5A53;
    font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 5.625pt;
    letter-spacing: 0.15em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    border-bottom: 0.75pt solid #111111;
    padding-bottom: 6pt;
  }
}
@page sec41 {
  @top-left { content: none }
  @top-center { content: none }
  @top-right { content: none }
  @bottom-left {
    content: "Northmoor product catalog 2026–27 · Section 4, utility skids";
    font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 5.625pt;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #8A857E;
  }
  @bottom-right {
    content: "Page 4.1";
    font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 5.625pt;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #8A857E;
  }
}
.page41 { page: sec41 }
.sheet { position: relative; }
.atop { position: absolute; top: -52.5pt; left: -57pt; right: -57pt; height: 3pt; background-color: #7B2233; }
.prodgrid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 22.5pt; margin-top: 18pt; }
.prodgrid3 { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 18pt; }
.ph-lg { height: 112.5pt; }
.ph-sm { height: 90pt; }
.prodname { font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.25pt; line-height: 1.3; margin-top: 8.25pt; }
.prodname-sm { font-size: 7.875pt; margin-top: 6.75pt; }
.proddesc { font-size: 7.125pt; line-height: 1.65; color: #444444; margin-top: 3.75pt; }
.proddesc-sm { font-size: 6.75pt; line-height: 1.6; margin-top: 3pt; }
.prodprice { font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.5pt; line-height: 1; margin-top: 6pt; }
.pricetable { font-size: 6.75pt; margin-top: 7.5pt; }
.small-t { font-size: 6.75pt; }
.p2 { break-before: page; }
.howto { display: flex; gap: 22.5pt; margin-top: 19.5pt; }
.howto > div { width: 50%; font-size: 7.125pt; line-height: 1.75; }
```

</CodeGroup>

Both files assume [`northmoor-shared.css`](https://github.com/formepdf/forme/blob/main/templates/northmoor-shared.css) alongside them — the set's shared spine (type scale, tables, signature blocks, the accent).
